meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Perera Et Al

rules.statement: The mere massing of the joint estate of husband and wife for the purposes of a joint will does not by itself constitute adiation of inheritance under the will by either spouse.
rules.supporting_quote: "The mere massing of the joint estate of husband and wife for the purposes of a joint will does not by itself constitute adiation of inheritance under the will by either spouse."
